p.i: epentinum & immaturum obitum fum-morum Germania Principum,

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISS. PRINCIPIS, IOANNIS CASIMIRI, Comitis Palatini ad Rhenum, Palatinatus electoralis administratoris, Bavariae Ducis, &c.
ILLVSTRISS. PRINCIPIS, Nomine & CHRISTIANI, Ducis Ax.[?] S.R.I. Electoris, Landgr. Thuringiae, Marchionis Misniae, Burggr. Magdeb.&c.
THRENVS.

p.i: Illinsculpta opus est sit cuiquam marmora narrent Quantus superstes sixeris, tuis[?] in miris, dux Casimire, piorum Tutela fortis omnium defensa tuis iterumque iterūq; sub armis Testatur (ecce) Francia. tuis[?] hoc seruanda tuis si fata tulissent, Testatur omnis Belgica.

main_text.p: [?] Several words of the verse are printed in a damaged or worn state; readings marked [?] are uncertain.

page.notes: The verse stanza has a bracket at its left edge and a few ink spots and show-through, which are not printed text. The first word of the verse is partly obscured. "Ax." in the dedication is uncertain. The initial letter of the dedication heading is a large decorative capital and is partly worn.
